reason: My Indian bank's NRI desk does this for a few hundred rupees in charges, and I would not hand a lakh-sized transfer to a company I have never heard of. $149 to $199 on top of the CA fee I already pay my own accountant feels like a lot.
objection: I do not know this company, and paying $149-$199 to move money my own bank will move for a few hundred rupees looks like paying for something I can do myself.
would_change_my_mind: My own Indian bank or my Canadian bank recommending it, or the fee being under about $60 for a 10 lakh transfer, with the CA certificate included.
